opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000 plus 5% contribution to administration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities; not individuals; must deliver outstanding quality teaching.
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours (e.g., weekend, evenings, holidays).

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000 plus 5% contribution to administration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities that can demonstrate outstanding teaching; universities are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per year per undergraduate or postgraduate student in the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution up to £56,000 (year 1) and £28,000 (years 2‑3); up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers without a permanent full‑time academic post; must hold a doctorate; UK resident; cannot be registered for other degrees; specific career‑break rules apply.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowship enabling early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers (or partially retired) who have lived in the UK ≥26 weeks per year and held a UK university post; must be research‑active.
opportunities.summary: 3‑24 month fellowship to complete or integrate a research project for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards up to £5 million total; each award funds 18 four‑year doctoral scholarships (plus additional master‑plus‑PhD and postdoctoral places)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two UK universities).
opportunities.summary: Centenary doctoral scholarships supporting interdisciplinary research, including provisions for under‑represented groups, master‑plus‑PhD routes and postdoctoral opportunities.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with the Office for Students and holding research degree awarding powers); can be single or multi‑institution centres.
opportunities.summary: Large‑scale research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship across any discipline.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution (starting at junior lecturer scale) + up to £6,000 per year research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established distinguished researchers employed at an eligible UK university; must not have held a previous Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowship to enable senior researchers to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes); PI must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative and original research projects, covering staff costs, consumables, travel and other eligible expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) coordinating the visit; host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Invite an eminent overseas professor for a 3‑12 month visit to bring novel expertise and enhance skills of staff and students.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs; 4‑5 year duration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with ≥2 years post‑PhD experience; must hold (or be nominated for) a permanent UK university appointment at lecturer level or above.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career researchers to build a modest research team and demonstrate leadership, aiming for transformative impact.
